title: Zeus Issariotis
extracted_sentences: Carl Zeus Issariotis (born June 26, 1981 in Toronto, Ontario) is a Canadian figure skater who currently represents Greece internationally.
He is the 2004 & 2006 Greek national champion.
He previously competed representing Canada, most notably on the Junior Grand Prix circuit, but switched to representing Greece after taking a break from competitive skating .
